title: Generic STAR-CCM+ case audit
description: Structured audits and explicitly isolated geometry/mesh/physics probes for existing .sim cases.

preflight.description: Inventory geometry, regions, physics, boundaries, interfaces and reports.

audit-axial-caps.description: Read-only measurement of the legacy propeller inlet and outlet Z planes.

audit-boundary-physics.description: Read-only inventory of boundary profile classes and region continuum assignments.

audit-reference-frames.description: Read-only inventory of reference frames, rotating axes, origins and angular rates.

audit-mrf-mesh-configuration.description: Read-only inventory of the MRF auto mesh input parts, base size, prism layers and selected surface controls.

export-mrf-rotating-stl.description: Read-only export of the rotating MRF fluid and its three selected source parts as binary STL for topology and geometry-role diagnosis.

probe-mrf-rotating-only-mesh.description: On an isolated copy, mesh only the rotating fluid part to distinguish intrinsic geometry failure from two-part meshing conflict.

audit-mrf-split-mesh-configuration.description: Read-only audit of independent stationary and rotating MRF auto mesh operation inputs and controls.

audit-mrf-volume-mesh-quality.description: Read-only volume-cell counts and per-Region cell quality, face validity and volume change for every meshed Region.

diagnose-mrf-low-volume-change.description: On an isolated copy, locate rotating MRF cells below the Siemens 2502 Volume Change guidance and export their values.

probe-gmsh-cgns-import.description: Import a content-hashed Gmsh CGNS volume mesh into an isolated simulation and record new Regions, boundaries and cells.

audit-gmsh-cgns-import.description: Measure cell count, physical volume and STAR mesh-quality minima on an imported CGNS Region.

probe-imported-mrf-interfaces.description: On an isolated copy, connect the three audited CGNS rotor/stator envelope boundary pairs.

diagnose-imported-gmsh-volume-change.description: Locate imported Gmsh cells below the explicit Volume Change pilot gate without changing the mesh.

clean-imported-mrf-host.description: After an explicit four-region audit, remove the two named legacy regions and interfaces from an isolated imported rotor/stator mesh copy.

audit-imported-mrf-boundary-faces.description: Read actual face counts on explicitly selected outer and interface boundaries of a paired imported MRF mesh.

configure-imported-mrf-physics-pilot.description: Apply explicit synthetic-rotor inlet, outlet, farfield and MRF-frame settings to an isolated audited imported mesh copy; initialize and confirm interface faces without solving.

solve-imported-mrf-smoke-100.description: Run exactly 100 iterations on an explicitly initialized two-region MRF mesh in an isolated copy; records iteration progress and saves a checkpoint, without claiming convergence.

audit-imported-mrf-residuals.description: Export available STAR residual monitor histories from a saved MRF checkpoint and record the final samples without advancing the solver.

repair-imported-mrf-reports.description: On an isolated two-region MRF checkpoint, bind inherited force and moment reports to rotor wall boundaries and density to the stator Region; save only after finite report values are verified.

diagnose-imported-mrf-face-validity.description: On an isolated copy, initialize, count cells below Face Validity 1 with CellSet, and spatially localize each bad cell by coordinate-box subdivision; no mesh changes. case_spec.mesh_region_name selects the Region for STAR preview and extent validation.
